Each idea gets an equation, a picture and the code, in that order.

## The Equation

$$
\bar{x} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i
$$

## The Picture

```{r first-chapter-figure, echo=FALSE}
run_chunk("first-chapter-code")
tibble(x = x) |>
  ggplot(aes(x)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "#467AAC") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = x_bar, linewidth = 1)
```

## The Code

```{r first-chapter-code}
set.seed(1)
x <- rnorm(100, mean = 10, sd = 2)
x_bar <- sum(x) / length(x)
x_bar
```
